verdict.rationale: Brave heavily markets natural-language/agentic integration via MCP servers, LLM Context endpoint, and guides for Claude, Dify, OpenClaw, etc., suggesting strong support for AI-native natural-language operation (docs-12,15,26,37,38). However, community evidence shows the standard API ToS explicitly prohibits using responses for AI inference, requiring a separate paid AI Inference plan to legitimately use it with agents like OpenClaw, contradicting the marketed use case.
